title: NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier
summary: PrimeIntellect's research project exploring extreme optimization and acceleration of NanoGPT (Andrej Karpathy's minimal GPT implementation), likely focusing on distributed training techniques and performance improvements to push the boundaries of what's achievable with this educational codebase.
